metadata.title: COBO L2 Windows Endpoint SSPP
metadata.remarks: Operating system–specific System Security and Privacy Plan defining how Microsoft Windows endpoints implement the COBO L2 enhanced-assurance endpoint trust tier.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: A Microsoft Windows endpoint configured to meet enhanced COBO L2 requirements for sensitive data handling, privileged workflows, and elevated institutional assurance.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: This Windows SSPP inherits all COBO L2 requirements and all underlying COBO L1 Windows requirements.

props.name: supported-versions
props.remarks: Only currently supported Windows 11 releases are permitted.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: Windows endpoint is owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: Windows endpoint is centrally enrolled and governed using institutional endpoint management services.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: Windows endpoint identity must use TPM-backed private keys, PKI-issued device certificates, and support hardware attestation.

props.name: cryptographic-compliance
props.remarks: Windows cryptographic subsystems must operate in FIPS 140-3–compliant mode where applicable.

props.name: secure-boot-and-boot-measurement
props.remarks: UEFI Secure Boot and Windows measured boot must be enabled and support attestation.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: Windows configuration applies CIS Windows Benchmark Level 2 (or equivalent enhanced) settings.

props.name: credential-protection
props.remarks: Virtualization-Based Security, Credential Guard, and related protections must be enabled to protect secrets and credentials.

props.name: defender-advanced-protection
props.remarks: Advanced Microsoft Defender features for EDR, attack surface reduction, and isolation must be enabled.

props.name: posture-and-health-reporting
props.remarks: Windows endpoints continuously report posture and health signals with higher assurance guarantees than COBO L1.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Windows COBO L2 endpoints may participate in workflows involving Data Classification Levels 1, 2, and 3.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: Enhanced endpoint assurance does not confer automatic entitlement to any data classification.

props.name: privileged-workload-support
props.remarks: Windows COBO L2 endpoints may be used for privileged and administrative workflows where explicitly authorized.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Windows COBO L2 endpoints are subject to heightened lifecycle governance, including stricter suspension, recovery, and audit requirements.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP defines how Windows implements COBO L2 enhanced endpoint trust through stricter configuration, stronger identity assurance, and advanced runtime protection.

control-implementation.remarks: Windows security baselines, Group Policy objects, MDM profiles, and Defender configurations realize this SSPP and are maintained as versioned implementation artifacts.
